scope: read-only design/source review; no source edits, process launches, native/lease queries, builds or infrastructure
existing_design_risks: run_owned_process parent timeout enters legacy termination and later receipt persistence; it is not an independent all-operation hard watchdog
_fallback_reap_after_error uses numeric PID signals, drops enumeration errors to an empty list, and resets grace/reap deadlines
_supervisor_main materializes both full output files as decoded strings and then JSON, followed by another parent copy
_reap_adopted_children returns only count; observed PID/status events and terminal ECHILD must become separate facts without stealing direct Popen wait status

approved_minimal_source_increment.entry: explicit opt-in source-control schema/transport seam on accepted22f; legacy default path and native flags unchanged
approved_minimal_source_increment.identity_type: OwnedIdentity(pid, finite_create_time); keys use the entire pair, with verified root/capture provenance
approved_minimal_source_increment.census_row_type: OwnedCensusRow(identity or unavailable observation, state live/zombie/absent/reused/unknown, observed_at, fixed error classes); unknown is not an owned identity
approved_minimal_source_increment.reap_event_type: OwnedReapEvent(pid, raw_wait_status, observed_at, matched_identity or unavailable); count alone is not a reap ledger
approved_minimal_source_increment.cleanup_evidence_type: OwnedCleanupEvidence(schema_version, scope, root identity, enumeration success/errors, full sorted ledger, reap events, terminal_echild True/False/unavailable, reader/sampler observations unavailable unless measured, deadline facts unavailable unless supplied)
approved_minimal_source_increment.completion_rule: An empty ledger alone never establishes success. Completion requires explicit successful enumeration and root/reap evidence, with no live/zombie/unknown/reused rows or observation errors; missing/unavailable observations cannot be normalized to clean facts. Absence alone is not an observed reap event.
approved_minimal_source_increment.outcome_attachment: Same cleanup_evidence field for CompletedProcess, TimeoutExpired and ProcessTreeCleanupError; preserve original object identity, returncode, existing stdout/stderr/output and primary exception; record fixed secondary errors separately
approved_minimal_source_increment.allowed_tests: pure/injected more-than64 rows, same PID/different births, empty-vs-failed enumeration, no-signal unknown/reuse seams, result/timeout/error serialization and attachment identity, controlled deadline budgets; no RCC/provider/lease commands
approved_minimal_source_increment.disallowed_wiring: native two-node execution, new signals/fallback changes, disk output creation, lease observation or watchdog implementation until the corresponding design is accepted

full_design_holds: Name a genuinely independent guardian or admitted external endpoint covering controller plus subreaper, census, readers/sampler, raw-output hashing, fsync and final receipt persistence; no Python-thread watchdog inside the blocking process
Before any primary640 claim specify and qualify independent630TERM/640KILL or an explicitly admitted alternative; values remain proposals, not native authority
Define immutable absolute endpoint ordering and one origin; no native fallback may call legacy grace-reset/rawPID-signalling behavior

Choose native-only disk-output outcome contract with no-follow owned namespace and byte/hash verification; retain legacy in-memory output defaults, and do not silently replace stdout/stderr strings with references

Define failure publication including missing/partial output, malformed transport, census failure and blocked persistence; watchdog intervention can only FAIL with unavailable facts, never cleanup success
Pin exact accepted22f source/profile and exact2node/n0 dispatch; reject unset/unaccepted budgets, self-cgroup HOLD or missing resource admission before flags/process creation

architecture_comparison.same_process_deadline_only: rejected as hard-bound design because blocking census/filesystem operations do not consult Python deadline
architecture_comparison.existing_subreaper_plus_independent_oute: preferred full shape, pending owner/identity/escalation/output contract and budget admission; reuse one supervisor for two serial nodes

documentation_proposal.exact_text: An absolute Python deadline limits only operations that consume its remaining budget. Final census, output hashing, fsync, and receipt persistence require an independently enforced outer endpoint before a whole-operation hard bound is claimed. Watchdog intervention is failure with explicitly unavailable cleanup facts; it is not evidence that owned processes were reaped.
documentation_proposal.learning: hard deadline ownership must remain outside the operations it bounds
documentation_proposal.evidence: accepted22f supervisor/fallback/output/persistence source and reviewed plan
documentation_proposal.stale_guidance: c564 baseline and implied hard endpoint without concrete independent enforcer
documentation_proposal.uncertainty: numeric native budgets, watchdog/transport wiring, resource/self-cgroup and passive lease observation remain unaccepted

native_execution: HOLD; budgets unset/unaccepted and self-cgroup binding unqualified
